data.narrative:
Base Power, a Series C climate and energy company founded by Zach Dell and Justin Lopas, has raised over $1.0B to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of three private companies at the same stage and sector—KoBold Metals ($3.0B), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B), and Amogy ($700M)—along with reference to a broader universe of nine private frontier-tech peers and one public comparable (LNZA).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised ($1.0B) as a proxy baseline and applying a typical Series C step-up multiplier of 1.7x, implies a valuation of $1.7B. Peer-median analysis across the three same-stage, same-sector comparables yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $700M to $3.0B. These methods reflect material dispersion in recent Series C pricing within climate and energy.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $850M (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $1.4B. The $1.2B spread reflects both the inherent variance in peer stage-progression and the wide dispersion observed in the comparable set—a function of sector heterogeneity and varying paths to commercialization. Key uncertainties include technology maturity, capital deployment runway, and the near-term path to cash generation relative to peer timelines.
